mapper.sql: r.id, r.image_id, i.image_code, i.image_url, r.model_version_id, r.predicted_species_id, s.herb_name AS predicted_species_name, r.predicted_name, r.confidence, r.recognition_status, r.recognition_time, r.raw_result
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO herb_image_recognition ( image_id, model_version_id, predicted_species_id, predicted_name, confidence, recognition_status, recognition_time, raw_result, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{imageId}, #{modelVersionId}, #{predictedSpeciesId}, #{predictedName}, #{confidence}, #{recognitionStatus}, #{recognitionTime}, #{rawResult}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM herb_image_recognition r LEFT JOIN herb_image i ON i.id = r.image_id AND i.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN herb_species s ON s.id = r.predicted_species_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE r.image_id = #{imageId} AND r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.recognition_time DESC, r.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
